description: Check the text of a draft label for a listed medicine in Australia against TGO 116, as takefridayoff.com/guides/supplement-labelling sets it out: each active ingredient with its quantity, the dosage form, the pack quantity, the AUST L number, the batch and expiry with their identifiers, storage, the sponsor and its contact, warnings under their heading, directions and the indications, with declared substances, the sugar-alcohol statement and the PO box rule. Then flags the words a label can't use ("TGA approved", safe, guaranteed). Each item quotes the guide with its link. It reads words, not the artwork, so layout, text size and placement are not checked. Not legal advice.

label.description: The label's text, every panel: the name, actives and quantities, directions, warnings, storage, batch and expiry, the sponsor

pathway.description: listed_medicine (AUST L, the default) or assessed_listed_medicine (AUST L(A))

name: tfo_label_check
title: Check a draft label
